scan_table_check.description: Users must have an Identity Type. Any user without an Identity Type ("Human", "Machine" or "AI") indicates an inconsistent, outdated or defective user import or creation process that should be fixed. Note that user that were created prior to the Australia releae typically do not have an identity type. The OOTB technical user "playbook.automation_runner" is considered as an exception because the user is protected against any change and shipped without an identity type.
scan_table_check.name: DataSanity - Users without Identity Type
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Set the Identity Type for existing users as applicable. Fix the root cause for users being created or imported without identity Type.
scan_table_check.short_description: Users must have an Identity Type
